questions.prompt: Which clause filters rows before any grouping happens?
questions.explanation: WHERE filters individual rows; HAVING filters groups after GROUP BY.

questions.prompt: Which JOIN keeps every row from the left table even with no match on the right?
questions.explanation: LEFT JOIN preserves all left-hand rows, filling unmatched right columns with NULL.

questions.prompt: What does COUNT(column) do differently from COUNT(*)?
options: It skips NULLs in that column
It errors on an empty table
questions.explanation: COUNT(column) ignores NULLs, while COUNT(*) counts every row.

questions.prompt: Which window function assigns 1, 2, 2, 4 to a tied ranking?
questions.explanation: RANK() leaves gaps after ties; DENSE_RANK() would give 1, 2, 2, 3.
